# Copilot instructions

This repository also has an `AGENTS.md` (project brief + build/test commands) and detailed
C# rules in `.github/instructions/csharp.instructions.md`. Follow both.

When working in this repo:
- Prefer the smallest diff that solves the problem; don't reformat unrelated code.
- Match the existing style exactly. If a convention is unclear, ask before guessing.
- When you add or change behaviour, add or update a test in the same change.
- Briefly explain any non-obvious trade-off you made.
